description_en: Queries information about a Smart Access Gateway device by calling the DescribeSAGDeviceInfo operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeSAGDeviceInfo接口查询智能接入网关设备信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-sag-device-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-7f3d9b6jwnuqn60000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSAGDeviceInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Smart Access Gateway
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the associated Smart Access Gateway device
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

ControllerState.description_en:
The control status of the Smart Access Gateway device. Valid values:

Normal: Normal.
Abnormal: Abnormal
ControllerState.description_zh:
智能接入网关设备的管控状态：

Normal：正常。
Abnormal：异常

LastConnectedControllerTime.description_en: The most recent time when the Smart Access Gateway device connected to the controller
LastConnectedControllerTime.description_zh: 智能接入网关设备最近一次连接管控的时间

ResettableStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the reset button of the Smart Access Gateway device is enabled. Valid values:

Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
ResettableStatus.description_zh:
智能接入网关设备的重置键是否启用。

Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：未启用

ServiceIP.description_en: The service IP address of the Smart Access Gateway device
ServiceIP.description_zh: 智能接入网关设备的业务IP地址

SmartAGType.description_en:
The type of the Smart Access Gateway device. Valid values:

sag-100wm.
sag-1000
SmartAGType.description_zh:
智能接入网关设备类型：

sag-100wm。
sag-1000

StartupTime.description_en: The startup time of the Smart Access Gateway device
StartupTime.description_zh: 智能接入网关设备的启动时间

SynStatus.description_en:
The synchronization status between the local Smart Access Gateway device and the cloud. Valid values:

Synchronized: Synchronization is complete.
Unsynchronized: Not synchronized.
Synchronizing: Synchronization is in progress
SynStatus.description_zh:
智能接入网关设备本地和云上的同步状态：

Synchronized：同步完成。
Unsynchronized：未同步。
Synchronizing：正在同步

Version.description_en: The software version that runs on the Smart Access Gateway device
Version.description_zh: 智能接入网关设备运行的软件版本号

VpnState.description_en:
The VPN connection status of the Smart Access Gateway device. Valid values:

Normal: Normal.
Abnormal: Abnormal
VpnState.description_zh:
智能接入网关设备的VPN连接状态：

Normal：正常。
Abnormal：异常
